basis: ShARP futures band on the campaign's common basis (S006)
justification: The band spans roughly 0.77 to 1.65 times ShARP's own planned quantity across the campaign's milestones; the grid's 0.6 to 2.0 span sits outside that band on both ends, so it samples beyond ShARP's disclosed futures rather than reproducing them.

Runs from twice the Step Change path's own cap intensity down to near zero, approximately log spaced (step ratios 2.00 to 2.50, geometric mean 2.354) so the marginal abatement cost curve is sampled evenly across orders of magnitude rather than crowded at the shallow end.

basis: Extends the dashboard's existing decode convention (S005)
justification: Demand keys keep the three-digit width (value x100) the dashboard already parses; intensity keys widen to four digits (value x1000) because the two deepest levels need a fourth significant digit to stay distinct from each other.
key: Digit width and scale per axis
value: d0XX x100 (3 digits); i0XXX x1000 (4 digits)

basis: Arithmetic and grid mechanics (S001, S002, S003)
justification: d100_i1000 holds both axes at the base chain's own value for that year, so it reproduces the base chain's own cap and load exactly; it is still solved as its own single-year branch row so the grid method can be checked against the chain it is built from.

basis: Plan's own pipeline ceiling (S001); mechanism documented in S007 and S008
justification: The 2030 period's new-entrant build is capped at pipeline_rush_ceiling_mw, 41,000 MW for generation and 10,200 MW for storage, above a free allowance of 20,500 MW and 5,100 MW (new_entrant_cap_mw_by_year). A high-demand 2030 cell can still ask for more new capacity than the ceiling allows and may be infeasible or shed load. The near-term pipeline and pre-2030 rush-charge topics derive how the allowance and ceiling are built but carry different worked totals (19,000/13,000 MW generation, 0 MW storage, a 26,000/6,000 MW ceiling) than the plan's current figures.
used_for: Expected corner behaviour at high demand in 2030

basis: Biomass residual emissions under a deep cap (S010)
justification: At the deepest intensity levels in 2050 to 2060 the absolute cap intensity falls to a small fraction of a tonne per gigawatt hour, in the range where the fork's own carbon-cap probe already found a biomass fleet's residual methane and nitrous oxide emissions alone can approach or exceed a comparably deep cap. The probe's own figures are on a different trajectory and an earlier cap ladder, so only the direction, not the exact percentage, carries over: those cells may be infeasible or meet the cap only through unserved energy.
used_for: Expected corner behaviour at the deepest intensity levels

justification: About a third of the binding renewable energy zone (REZ) and corridor ceilings in the deepest-cap reference run still bind after doubling every limit. The campaign's own launches relax further than that probed 2x, but the probed finding, that some ceilings do not clear at any plausible relaxation, still sets the expectation that the highest demand levels may be infeasible or shed load at some REZs.
used_for: Expected corner behaviour at high demand across all years
value: doubled in the probed run; relaxed further in campaign launches
